flags.X_T: any present F-K1 pair agrees false
flags.C_T: any present F-K2 pair agrees false
flags.G_T: any present F-K3 pair agrees false

items.defensible_if: not applicable (criterion, not a derived tolerance)
items.report_rule: if G_T, the main report states GPU self-nondeterminism of transforms on fixtures; a main K1 not_supported is then not attributable to CPU/GPU disagreement alone

items.qualifying_pairs: present coords pairs whose same-arm-pair transforms pair (same fixture, replicate) is present and agrees
items.statistic: Mxyz = max max_abs_error over qualifying pairs (agreeing pair = 0)
items.defensible_if: validity V0 and completeness Z hold; no qualifying pair with agrees false and null max_abs_error; every fixture has >= 4 qualifying F-K8 pairs; Mxyz <= 0.001

items.statistic: MR = max max_rel_error over present F-K4, F-K5, F-K6 pairs (agreeing pair = 0); per fixture MRx_f, MRc_f, MRg_f

formula.atol: 10^-d, d = max digits after the decimal point among score tokens of present A0 docking.out files

items.analytic_ceiling: A_rel(N_f) = (3*log2(N_f^3) + 1) * 5 * 2^-24 * N_f^1.5, N_f = first token of the first line of A0's docking.out for fixture f
items.defensible_if: V0 and Z hold; no present pair with agrees false and null max_rel_error; for every fixture max(MRx_f, MRc_f, MRg_f) <= A_rel(N_f)

items.qualifying_pairs: present dockq pairs whose same-arm-pair transforms pair is present and agrees
items.statistic: Me = max max_abs_error over qualifying pairs (agreeing pair = 0)
items.defensible_if: V0 and Z hold; no qualifying pair with agrees false and null max_abs_error; every fixture has >= 4 qualifying F-K11 pairs; eps_eval <= 0.01

constants.up2: smallest m*10^e >= x with integer m in [10,99]

applicability: main run's system.executables (megadock, megadock-gpu, evaluator) sha256 and library sets, driver_version, cuda_version and GPU name equal the fixture run's; otherwise margins reported as not applicable and outcomes recorded unchanged

validity.V0: comparison_scored.json exists, seal matches, evaluate PASS
validity.Z: every fixture comparison has >= 4 present pairs for every fixture
